notes.title: Version 1.2.0 - Score system + rain effect + gamepad support + tutorial
notes.content:
Hello everyone and Happy Easter!

Today I am not bringing anything new related to the holiday, but better: some basic stuff missing that improves the overall gameplay and feel! Such as:

[list]
[*]Difficult display on the song selection screen
[*]You can now see how well you hit a note (good, perfect) or if you missed it
[*]Additional cat animations
[*]Score system using grades from A to F (and S)
[*]You can now play with your gamepad
[*]New tutorial screen
[*]Control schemas added to the title screen and in the screen above
[*]If you miss too much notes it will start to rain!
[/list]

Have fun!

notes.title: Game options + menu fixes!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

For this first update of Fish and Groove I have included some options for the game:

- Sound volume
- Fullscreen/windowed mode
- Game exit

I have also fixed the mouse usage on all the menus. It is a small update, but I hope it improves your fun!
